_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Maccido {player_id} a wasan Liar's Dice na {num_players}-player.
Ka'idoji:
- A zagayen ku, ku na iya:
  1) Yi sabon bid tare da adadi mafi girma ko face mafi girma (ko biyun) fiye da bid na yanzu; ma'ana '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kira bid na ƙarshe ta hanyar rubuta '[Call]'.

Idan ku kira:
  - Idan adadin gaskiya na face value a tsakanin duka dice yake ƙasa da bid, na ƙarshe bid na asara daya die.
  - A sahali, mai kira ya asara daya die.
Maccido wanda ya kai dice 0 an cire shi. Maccido na ƙarshe ya ci.

board.new_round:
Sabon zagaye - Dice masu kulla: {dice_summary}
Dice na yanzu: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Maccido {current_player_id} ya kira! Adadin gaskiya na face {face_value} shi ne {count}, wanda yake ƙasa da {quantity}.
Maccido {loser_id} (na ƙarshe bid) asara daya die.
call.caller_loses:
Maccido {current_player_id} ya kira! Adadin gaskiya na face {face_value} shi ne {count}, wanda yake >= {quantity}.
Maccido {loser_id} (mai kira) asara daya die.

action.bid_announce: Maccido {player_id} ina bid {quantity} na ngel face {face_value}.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aikin ba a gane shi a matsayin ko '[Bid: X, Y]' ko '[Call]' na gaske. Aikin da aka gabatar: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Sabuwar adadi {new_quantity} kasa da na yanzu {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Sabuwar face value {new_face_value} kasa da na yanzu {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Jaɓɓorgo Caka jaɓugo jawdi je ɗon jooni.
bid_reason.face_range: Face value must be between 1 and 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} was eliminated by invalid move.
